mined.name: transfer_when_action_possible
mined.description: Blocks transfers when the user's request is executable under policy, such as changing cabin on a basic economy reservation (when no flight has flown), upgrading then cancelling, or booking for a saved passenger using the booking user's profile.
mined.clause: Transfer only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. Cabin changes, including on basic economy reservations, are allowed if no flight has flown; booking may use the booking user's own user id and profile data.

mined.name: cancel_uncovered_reason
mined.description: Blocks cancelling a reservation when the stated reason is not covered by travel insurance and no other cancellation condition applies, or when a flight has already flown.
mined.clause: A flight can be cancelled only if the booking was made within the last 24 hrs, the flight was cancelled by the airline, it is a business flight, or the user has travel insurance and the reason is covered. If any portion has already been flown, transfer is needed.

mined.name: invalid_layover
mined.description: Blocks flight updates or bookings whose consecutive segments connect at the same airport but the next departure is at or before the previous arrival.
mined.clause: Consistency rule: a proposed connection must have a positive layover; zero or negative layover is not a workable connection.

mined.name: price_rank_mismatch
mined.description: Blocks booking or changing to an itinerary that is more expensive than the user's requested rank (cheapest or second cheapest) among all options present in the search history for the same one-way route, date, and cabin.
mined.clause: Consistency rule: when the user asks for the cheapest or second cheapest fare, the selected itinerary must match that price rank across direct and one-stop options.

mined.name: update_flights_wrong_destination
mined.description: Blocks an update to flights when the user has positively requested a different destination airport than the one used in the proposed itinerary and the requested airport is absent from the update.
mined.clause: Consistency rule: a modification must keep the same origin and destination. If the user wants a different destination, do not call update_reservation_flights with the old destination; use cancel-and-rebook when eligible.

mined.name: book_reservation_payment_method_count_limit
mined.description: Blocks a booking whose payment methods exceed the allowed counts of travel certificates, gift cards, or credit cards.
mined.clause: Each reservation can use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards.

mined.name: payment_method_in_profile
mined.description: Stop database-updating calls that use a payment method not present in the user's profile.
mined.clause: All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.

mined.name: cancel_reservation_eligibility
mined.description: Stop cancellation when the available reservation facts show no policy condition for cancellation is met.
mined.clause: Flight can be cancelled only if booking was within last 24 hrs, airline cancelled flight, it is a business flight, or travel insurance covers cancellation reason.

mined.name: book_reservation_flight_direction
mined.description: Stop booking calls whose flight numbers contradict the requested origin/destination direction.
mined.clause: Book flight requires the correct origin, destination, and trip type; flights must match the requested itinerary.

mined.name: send_certificate_requires_change_or_cancel
mined.description: Stop delayed-flight compensation when the user has not changed/cancelled and has even declined to do so.
mined.clause: For delayed-flight complaints, compensation may be offered only when the user wants to change or cancel the reservation and after the change or cancellation is performed.

mined.name: update_baggages_requires_explicit_extra_bag_request
mined.description: Stop baggage updates that charge for nonfree bags unless the user explicitly requested a specific number of extra/paid bags.
mined.clause: Do not add checked bags that the user does not need; extra baggage is charged only for requested additional bags.

mined.name: transfer_for_policy_exception_or_verification
mined.description: Stop transfers made for policy-exception requests, verification of policy claims, or supervisor escalation when the issue should be handled by denial or available compliant action.
mined.clause: Transfer only if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of available actions; deny requests against policy rather than transferring for exceptions or misinformation.

mined.name: transfer_when_actionable_request_remains
mined.description: Stops transfer_to_human_agents when a pending request can still be handled under policy, including basic-economy cabin changes, seat-adjacent bookings, future upgrades, or apparently eligible cancellations.
mined.clause: Transfer only if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of available actions; basic economy can still change cabin without changing flights, and other actionable requests should not be bypassed by transfer.

mined.name: cancel_reservation_requires_policy_eligibility
mined.description: Stops cancel_reservation when the target reservation is not eligible under cancellation rules or when any segment is already flown/needs status confirmation.
mined.clause: Flight can be cancelled only if made within last 24 hours, airline cancelled, business flight, or insurance covers reason; if any portion has flown, cancellation cannot be handled.

mined.name: update_flights_must_keep_valid_itinerary
mined.description: Stops update_reservation_flights when the proposed segment chain is disconnected or has an impossible connection where a later segment departs before the previous segment arrives.
mined.clause: Modified reservations cannot change origin, destination, or trip type; a valid itinerary must connect segments consistently.

mined.name: baggage_increase_requires_user_request
mined.description: Stops update_reservation_baggages when the call increases checked baggage without a positive user request to add/need checked bags.
mined.clause: Do not add checked bags that the user does not need; baggage changes require user confirmation of the desired checked baggage count.

mined.name: book_reservation_should_not_duplicate_existing_basic_economy
mined.description: Stops book_reservation when the user is trying to fix an existing basic-economy reservation on the same route, unless that reservation was cancelled first; policy allows cabin changes to enable modifications.
mined.clause: Before booking, existing reservations should be modified where policy permits; basic economy can still change cabin without changing flights.

mined.name: payment_methods_must_be_valid_and_within_limits
mined.description: Stops booking/write calls using payment methods not present in the user's profile, using more than one travel certificate on one booking, or using a credit card whose stored last four does not match the user's stated card.
mined.clause: All payment methods must already be in the user profile; each reservation can use at most one travel certificate; use the payment method selected by the user.
